name: fivebarn-life-admin
description: 17 skills that handle everyday life admin: inbox triage, school and activity to-dos, shopping carts, subscription savings, price drops and refunds, flight delays, trip planning, reservations, a morning briefing, calendar checks, goal planning, training plans, folder cleanup, brand deals, hiring, and event ticketing. Every skill asks before it sends, buys, books, or submits anything.
